decisions: Local desktop application: Python 3.11+, PySide6, Pillow, Shapely.
JPG + Foundry scene JSON input; original-size RGBA PNG output.
Use wall contours and manual brushing for the first terrain-removal workflow.
Temporary closures never enter source or exported Foundry JSON.
Target 16384 pixels per side; warn above 8192; validate memory before export.
Support Foundry 13 and 14 as explicit targets; keep raster export common and future scene adapters separate.
Elevation dropdown: 5-ft presets, custom whole feet; record intent in PNG metadata without claiming automatic Foundry placement.
Right-button drag pans in all tools, including at fit zoom.

validated.result: Offscreen synthetic editor screenshot inspected; text, wall overlays, closures, transparency, and elevation controls visible.
RGBA, dimensions, contour alpha, brush alpha, and elevation metadata verified.

pending.task: Validate import, scaling, padding, and wall alignment against real owner-provided JPG/JSON pairs in examples/.
Validate floor placement on Foundry 13 and 14, confirm exact builds/modules and scene units, then design version-specific scene/tile export adapters if needed.
Add a portable editing-session format with source fingerprints and safe reload.
Evaluate selected-region masking and edge refinement after real sample review.
Package a Windows executable after the editing workflow is validated.

limitations: No direct Foundry connection, scene mutation, or multi-floor scene assembly.
Unknown export variants require explicit adapter work rather than guessed coordinates.
Editor history is in-memory until persistent sessions are implemented.
